description_en: Submits a cleanup task for a scaling operation by calling the SubmitCleanTask operation
description_zh: 调用SubmitCleanTask接口提交清理扩容任务
name: SubmitCleanTask

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the DRDS instance
parameters.name: drds_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database to be scaled
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The task ID of the scaling task. This ID is returned when you submit the scaling task request
parameters.help_zh: 该扩容任务的任务ID，提交扩容任务的请求会返回
parameters.name: parent_job_id

parameters.help_en: The job ID of the scaling task. The value is the same as that of ParentJobId
parameters.help_zh: 该扩容任务的JobId，与ParentJobId取值相同
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The scaling type. Valid values:

smooth_expand: smooth scale-out
hot_expand: hotspot update
parameters.help_zh:
扩容类型，取值范围如下：
smooth_expand：平滑扩容
hot_expand：热点扩容
parameters.name: expand_type
